# Command reference

Every command Ono defines, grouped by family. `stability` says whether the contract is a promise; `phase` says which phase of spec §37 delivers it.

## container

### `get container`

Enumerate containers through the installed provider or providers.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.container.get` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | planned |
| input | `null` |
| output | `stream<ono.container/1>` |
| provider capability | `container.list` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | Resolve one container by id or name. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--all` | `bool` | Include containers that are not running. |
| `--provider` | `string` | Query one named container provider. |

**Examples**

```text
get container
get container | where state == running
```

### `start container`

Start a container.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.container.start` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | planned |
| input | `null | stream<ono.container/1>` |
| output | `stream<ono.action-result/1>` |
| provider capability | `container.manage` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | The container to start. |

**Examples**

```text

```

| | |
|---|---|

| input | `null | stream<ono.container/1>` |

### `set container`

Change a container's mutable configuration, such as its resource limits.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.container.set` |
| stability | experimental |
| phase | planned |
| input | `null | stream<ono.container/1>` |
| output | `stream<ono.action-result/1>` |
| provider capability | `container.manage` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--memory` | `bytesize` | New memory limit. |
| `--cpus` | `float` | New CPU allowance. |

**Examples**

```text

```

## data

### `where`

Filter a stream by a predicate.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.where` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<any>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `predicate` | `bool` | The predicate, evaluated with the current value's fields in scope (spec §10.3). |

**Examples**

```text
get process | where cpu > 20
get process | where cpu > 20 and user.name != "root"
get socket | where state == established
```

### `select`

Project fields and expressions into records.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.select` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<record>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `fields` | `list<string>` | The field paths to keep, in the order given. A record literal adds a computed field. |

**Examples**

```text
get process | select pid name memory
get process | select pid name {mem_mb: memory / 1MiB}
```

### `sort`

Order a finite input by an expression.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.sort` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<any>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | `value` | The expression to order by. |
| `direction` | `string` | `asc` or `desc`. |

**Examples**

```text
get process | sort memory desc
get process | sort cpu desc | take 10
```

### `group`

Group a finite or windowed stream by an expression.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.group` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<record>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | `value` | The expression to group by. |

**Examples**

```text
get process | group user.name
get socket | where state == established | group process.name
```

### `take`

Take the first N values.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.take` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<any>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | `int` | How many values to take. |

**Examples**

```text
get process | sort cpu desc | take 10
```

### `skip`

Skip the first N values.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.skip` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<any>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | `int` | How many values to skip. |

```text

```

### `each`

Map each value through an expression or block.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.each` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<any>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `body` | `value` | The expression or block to evaluate per value, with `@` bound to it (spec §19.4). |

**Examples**

```text
get service | where state == failed | each { restart service @ }
```

### `reduce`

Fold a stream into a single value.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.reduce` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `value` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `body` | `value` | The folding expression, with the accumulator and the current value in scope. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--initial` | `value` | The starting accumulator. Without it the first value seeds the fold and an empty stream is an error. |

**Examples**

```text
get process | select memory | reduce $acc + @ --initial 0
```

### `count`

Count the values of a finite input.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.count` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `int` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Examples**

```text
get process | count
echo (get process | count)
```

### `measure`

Compute statistics over a numeric stream.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.measure` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `ono.measure/1` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | `value` | The expression to measure. |

**Examples**

```text

```

### `to`

Serialize a value or stream into text or bytes.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.to` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `any` |
| output | `string | bytes` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `format` | `string` | One of `json`, `yaml`, `csv`, `text`, `bytes`. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--pretty` | `bool` | Indent the output for a human reader (spec §33.5). |
| `--human` | `bool` | Emit display forms such as `1.2 GiB` instead of canonical values. Off by default: §33.5 requires canonical values unless a human format is explicitly requested. |
| `--field` | `string` | For `text`, emit this one field per line — the bridge spec §29.1 writes for feeding an ordinary Unix tool. |

**Examples**

```text
get process | to json
get process | to json --pretty
get process | to json > out.json
```

### `from`

Parse an explicit representation into values.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.from` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | B |
| input | `string | bytes` |
| output | `value | stream<record>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `format` | `string` | One of `json`, `yaml`, `csv`. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--headers` | `bool` | For `csv`, treat the first row as field names. |

**Examples**

```text
curl -s https://example/api | from json | where status == "open"
```

### `format`

Render a value explicitly for a human.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.format` |
| stability | experimental |
| phase | B |
| input | `any` |
| output | `string` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `renderer` | `string` | `table`, `list`, `tree` or another registered renderer (spec §13). |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--columns` | `list<string>` | Override the schema's default column set. |
| `--max-rows` | `int` | Truncate after this many rows (spec §13.3). |

**Examples**

```text
get process | format table
get process | format table --columns [pid, name, memory]
```

### `tail`

Emit the last N values of a finite stream, or follow an unbounded one.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.tail` |
| stability | experimental |
| phase | planned |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<any>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | `int` | How many trailing values to emit. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--follow` | `bool` | Keep the stream open and emit values as they arrive. |

**Examples**

```text
get log --service nginx | tail 30
```

### `join`

Join two record streams on a key.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.join` |
| stability | experimental |
| phase | planned |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<record>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `right` | `value` | The stream to join against. |
| `on` | `value` | The key expression. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--kind` | `string` | `inner`, `left`, `right` or `outer`. |

**Examples**

```text
get process | join (get socket) --on pid
```

### `diff`

Compare two structured snapshots by identity and schema.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.data.diff` |
| stability | experimental |
| phase | planned |
| input | `stream<any>` |
| output | `stream<record>` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in expression mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `right` | `value` | The snapshot to compare against. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--identity` | `list<string>` | Override the schema's identity fields for the comparison. |

**Examples**

```text
get service | diff @-1
```

## file

### `get file`

Return file metadata records for the given paths.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.file.get` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `null` |
| output | `stream<ono.file/1>` |
| provider capability | `file.list` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | The path or glob to describe. Globs resolve to exact objects before anything acts on them (spec §17.3). |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--recursive` | `bool` | Descend into directories (spec §11.6, §6.2). |
| `--follow-symlinks` | `bool` | Describe the symlink target rather than the link itself. |

**Examples**

```text
get file ./src
get file /tmp --recursive | where modified < now()-30d
```

### `find file`

Discover files by walking a root, or through a provider index.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.file.find` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `null` |
| output | `stream<ono.file/1>` |
| provider capability | `file.find` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `path` | Where the search starts. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--depth` | `int` | Maximum depth to descend. |
| `--name` | `string` | Match entry names against a glob. |
| `--kind` | `string` | Restrict to one file kind. |
| `--follow-symlinks` | `bool` | Follow symlinks while walking; off by default, because it can cycle. |

**Examples**

```text
find file /var/log
find file /var/log | where size > 100MiB and modified < now()-30d
```

### `read file`

Return file content as bytes or text, according to an explicit detection policy.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.file.read` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `null | stream<ono.file/1>` |
| output | `bytes | string` |
| provider capability | `file.read` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | The file to read. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--encoding` | `string` | Decode as text in this encoding. Without it the content stays bytes — Ono does not guess (spec §12.1). |

**Examples**

```text
read file /etc/hostname --encoding utf-8
read file ./data.bin | to json
```

### `write file`

Consume pipeline content and write it with an explicit overwrite policy.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.file.write` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `bytes | string` |
| output | `ono.action-result/1` |
| provider capability | `file.write` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | The file to write. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--append` | `bool` | Append rather than replace. |
| `--overwrite` | `bool` | Permit replacing an existing file. Without it an existing target is `io.already_exists` (Ono-Sendai-E0303). |
| `--create` | `bool` | Create the file when it does not exist. |

**Examples**

```text
get process | to json | write file ./processes.json --overwrite
```

### `copy file`

Copy file resources.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.file.copy` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `null | stream<ono.file/1>` |
| output | `stream<ono.action-result/1>` |
| provider capability | `file.copy` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | `path` | What to copy. |
| `destination` | `path` | Where to copy it. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--recursive` | `bool` | Copy directories and their contents. |
| `--preserve` | `bool` | Preserve ownership, mode and timestamps where permitted. |
| `--overwrite` | `bool` | Permit replacing existing destinations. |

**Examples**

```text
copy file ./a.txt ./b.txt
```

|---|---|

| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `null | stream<ono.file/1>` |
| output | `stream<ono.action-result/1>` |

**Selectors**

### `remove file`

Delete file resources, with a destructive preview for broad selections.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.file.remove` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `null | stream<ono.file/1>` |
| output | `stream<ono.action-result/1>` |
| provider capability | `file.remove` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | What to delete; omitted when files arrive through the pipeline. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--recursive` | `bool` | Delete directories and their contents. |
| `--confirm` | `bool` | Confirm a bulk deletion non-interactively. Without it, a selection over the configured threshold fails with `safety.confirmation_required` in a script (spec §11.6, §17.4). |

**Examples**

```text
remove file ./build.tmp
find file /tmp | where modified < now()-30d | remove file
```

### `set file`

Change file metadata — mode, ownership or timestamps.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.file.set` |
| stability | experimental |
| phase | C |
| input | `null | stream<ono.file/1>` |
| output | `stream<ono.action-result/1>` |
| provider capability | `file.set` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | The file to modify. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--mode` | `string` | Permission bits as four octal digits, matching `ono.file/1`'s `mode` field. |
| `--owner` | `ref<ono.user/1>` | New owning user. |
| `--group` | `ref<ono.group/1>` | New owning group. |
| `--recursive` | `bool` | Apply to a directory's contents as well. |

**Examples**

```text
set file ./script.sh --mode 0755
```

| stability | experimental |

### `open file`

Open a file in its associated handler.

### `set plugin`

Change a package's management settings — enablement and background policy.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.plugin.set` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | I |
| input | `null | stream<ono.plugin/1>` |
| output | `stream<ono.action-result/1>` |
| provider capability | `plugin.set` |
| privilege | none |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | The package to configure. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--enabled` | `bool` | Make the package eligible for loading, or withdraw that eligibility (spec §31.3). Neither direction runs package code; disabling unloads a loaded instance first (lifecycle.v1.yaml, transitions `enable`/`disable`). |
| `--background` | `bool` | Let a package that declares a background role run jobs no command, view or subscription created (spec §31.38). Job lifetime stays scoped to Ono; KUANG/11 never silently creates system services. |

**Examples**

```text
set plugin dev.example.packet-eye --enabled false
set plugin dev.example.packet-eye --background true
```

| `--every` | `duration` | Polling interval where the provider has no event source (spec §18.2). |

**Examples**

```text
watch service nginx
watch service nginx &
```

### `get log`

Query log records as structured values rather than as parsed text.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.log.get` |
| stability | experimental |
| phase | planned |
| input | `null | ono.service/1` |
| output | `stream<ono.log-record/1>` |
| provider capability | `log.read` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--service` | `ref<ono.service/1>` | Restrict to one service unit's records (spec §33.2). |
| `--since` | `timestamp` | Only records at or after this time. |
| `--until` | `timestamp` | Only records at or before this time. |
| `--level` | `string` | Minimum severity. |

**Examples**

```text
get log --service nginx | tail 30
get log --service @1 | where level >= error | take 20
```

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.journal.get` |
| stability | planned |
| phase | planned |
| input | `null` |
| output | `stream<ono.log-record/1>` |
| provider capability | `log.read` |
| privilege | conditional |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--since` | `timestamp` | Only records at or after this time. |
| `--boot` | `int` | Restrict to one boot. |

**Examples**

```text
get journal --since (now() - 1h)
```

|---|---|
| id | `ono.journal.tail` |

|---|---|---|

**Examples**

```text
tail journal --lines 50
```

### `mount filesystem`

Mount a filesystem with validated options.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.filesystem.mount` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `null` |
| output | `ono.action-result/1` |
| provider capability | `mount.manage` |
| privilege | elevated |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | `string` | What to mount — a device, a network location or a pseudo-filesystem name. |
| `target` | `path` | Where to mount it. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--type` | `string` | Filesystem type; detected when omitted. |
| `--option` | `string` | One mount option per occurrence, never one joined string (spec §23.5). |
| `--read-only` | `bool` | Mount read-only. |

**Examples**

```text
mount filesystem /dev/sdb1 /mnt/data --read-only
```

### `unmount filesystem`

Unmount or detach a filesystem.

| | |
|---|---|
| id | `ono.filesystem.unmount` |
| stability | stable |
| phase | C |
| input | `null | stream<ono.mount/1>` |
| output | `stream<ono.action-result/1>` |
| provider capability | `mount.manage` |
| privilege | elevated |
| arguments | parsed in words mode (ADR-0009) |

**Selectors**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | `path` | The mount point to detach. |

**Options**

| name | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--lazy` | `bool` | Detach now and clean up when the last reference goes away. |
| `--force` | `bool` | Detach even with open references. Destructive for whatever holds them. |

**Examples**

```text
unmount filesystem /mnt/data
```
